The new deleteMany cleanup removes non-SMS reminders once their retryCount exceeds 1 because the retryCount branch is not scoped to method: SMS.
No concrete correctness issue is supported by the provided evidence for the migration itself.

findings.claim: The new pre-processing deleteMany uses an OR where only the first branch is constrained by `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`. Any workflow reminder of any method with `retryCount > 1` now matches the second branch and is permanently deleted by the SMS scheduler cron. This causes unrelated email/other reminders to be removed once they have retried twice, which is a correctness regression from an endpoint that should only manage SMS reminders.
findings.title: Cleanup query deletes reminders from other delivery methods
